description: This file defines the EntityEcaCondition class, which represents a condition for entity event-condition-action (ECA) in the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods for evaluating conditions based on entity fields or services, and provides mechanisms for comparison and service invocation within entity event handling.

classes.name: EntityEcaCondition
classes.description: Represents a condition used in entity event-condition-action (ECA) logic within OFBiz, capable of evaluating conditions based on entity fields or invoking service-based conditions, and supporting comparison operations.

methods.name: EntityEcaCondition
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the condition either as a service-based condition or based on XML element attributes defining entity field comparisons and formats.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates the condition, either by invoking a service or performing a comparison between entity field values, returning a boolean result.

methods.name: getLValue
methods.description: Returns the left-hand side field name of the condition.

methods.name: getRValue
methods.description: Returns the right-hand side value or field name, formatted as a string if it's a constant value.

methods.name: getOperator
methods.description: Returns the comparison operator used in the condition.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the condition, including service name or field names and operators.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code based on the condition's properties.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality between this condition and another object.

methods.name: getFieldNames
methods.description: Returns a list of involved field names for this condition.
